directions.note: Catalogue — museum-white cyclorama, clinical studio light, locked turntable. Chose the contrarian third: clinical white is the actual grammar of a product launch, and a full revolution loops cleanly for the seam check.

copy.note: Catalogue direction. 13 invented claims marked in {{...}}: manufacturer, unit designation, all numeric specs, one testimonial and three client names. Hero copy carries no data-in, per the progress-0 rule.

still.note: Centred, generous margin for a 360 turntable, hard silhouette on plain white for the cutout.

params.prompt: A nine-metre piloted armoured exoskeleton standing at rest, centred in frame, full body visible with generous empty margin on all sides and clear space above the helm. Japanese samurai armour construction reinterpreted as industrial machinery: overlapping lacquered plate in matte graphite and off-white, visible fasteners and panel lines, exposed hydraulic actuators at knee and elbow, a wide flared shoulder guard on each side, a broad horned helm crest, hands empty and at rest by its sides. Seamless museum-white cyclorama background, completely plain and uncluttered, even soft studio lighting from above and both sides, faint contact shadow beneath the feet. Neutral straight-on camera at chest height, 50mm lens, no perspective distortion. Clean industrial product photography. No text, no lettering, no logos, no signage, no people.
